title: Dashboard visual refresh
brief: Visual refresh of the EcoFlow Monitor dashboard (Expo app + web export): battery ring, power-flow diagram, Delta 2 / extra battery nodes, goal box

artboards.title: Aurora glass
artboards.tradeoff: Most striking and premium; glow and blur cost GPU on low-end Android and need fallbacks

artboards.title: Bento instrument
artboards.tradeoff: Clearest and cheapest to build; drops the connector-line diagram, so less 'flow' feeling

artboards.title: Light eco
artboards.tradeoff: Friendly and readable outdoors in sun; breaks the current dark identity and needs a full second palette

artboards.title: Flow polished
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the current flow structure; gas-plant input with a needed/when/how-long verdict; AC origin is non-blocking (starts unclassified, applied retroactively). Needs battery capacity, plant output, target % and a backend timestamp for AC arrival

artboards.title: Tower icon options
artboards.tradeoff: Seven pylon icon ideas (A-G) for the grid-power (Red) node; C (tower with bolt) chosen and applied to 04

artboards.title: Gas generator icon options
artboards.tradeoff: Seven portable generator icon ideas (A-G) for the Planta node; E (gas tank with flame) chosen and applied to 04

artboards.title: Solid-style generator options
artboards.tradeoff: Seven filled-glyph generator ideas (A-G); E (wheeled) with bolt cut-out plus a flame badge chosen and applied to 04

artboards.title: USB-C icon options
artboards.tradeoff: Five USB-C icon ideas (A-E) for the USB output node; B (front port) chosen and applied to the app

artboards.title: Diagram backgrounds
artboards.tradeoff: Five background ideas (A-E) for the card behind the power-flow diagram: blueprint grid, aurora, concentric waves, circuit, honeycomb. All static and cheap on native (gradients/patterns, no blur)
